text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care.
Seeing you scramble with bloodshot eyes,
struggling to win the Goddess of Victory's favor..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It was quite an entertaining tragicomedy.
This, too, shall become a fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I was thoroughly entertained by this fleeting moment.
Therefore... there is no need for pessimism."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
